words.page.title: ThoughtKnot: draw and edit the graphs in your notes
words.page.description: Free, open-source Obsidian plugin that draws the graphs in your notes and lets you edit them by typing or dragging. Offline and private, on desktop and mobile.
words.nav.label: Project links
words.hero.title: Draw the graphs you write in your notes
words.hero.lede: ThoughtKnot is a plugin for Obsidian. Write things and the links between them in a note, and it draws them. Change the graph by typing, or by tapping and dragging the drawing, and the note keeps up.
words.features.title: What it does
words.features.edit.title: Type it or drag it
words.features.edit.text: Edit the graph as text beside the note, or move and link things on the drawing. Both change the same note.
words.features.views.title: Seven ways to see it
words.features.views.text: Show the same graph as a network, a tree, a flow, a radial map, lanes, a timeline or a table.
words.features.problems.title: Problems, with their fixes
words.features.problems.text: A missing link or an unknown kind is shown on the drawing, with a fix you can apply in one step.
words.features.offline.title: Offline and private
words.features.offline.text: Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no update checks. AI is off until you set up a model yourself.
words.features.devices.title: Desktop and mobile
words.features.devices.text: Works wherever Obsidian runs, with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, in light and dark themes.
words.features.open.title: An open format
words.features.open.text: Graphs are plain text in your notes. The format has free libraries in JavaScript and Python, so other tools can read it too.
words.start.title: How to start
words.start.download: Download main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from the latest release.
words.start.copy: Put them in your vault, in the folder .obsidian/plugins/thoughtknot.
words.start.enable: In Obsidian, open Settings, then Community plugins, and turn on ThoughtKnot.
words.start.status: ThoughtKnot is still being built, so expect changes. It is not yet listed in Obsidian's community plugins.
